description: GDI-Südhessen: cycling and walking datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by GDI-Südhessen. Coverage: GDI-Südhessen. The listing groups 17 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about cycling and walking; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Radverkehrsanlagen GDI-Südhessen - Rundroute Bad Homburg; Radverkehrsanlagen GDI-Südhessen - Modau-Radroute; Radverkehrsanlagen GDI-Südhessen - Auenland Radroute; Radverkehrsanlagen GDI-Südhessen - Usatal-Radweg. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
